title: Body and Soul
composer: Johnny Green (lyrics Edward Heyman, Robert Sour, Frank Eyton)
original_issue: Columbia (single, 14 Sep 2011; album Duets II, 20 Sep 2011)
personnel: Tony Bennett (vocals); Amy Winehouse (vocals); Jorge Calandrelli (arranger, conductor); Elena Barere (concertmaster); Phil Ramone (producer)
trivia: Recorded at Abbey Road Studios in London on 23 March 2011 with producer Phil Ramone, this was the last recording Amy Winehouse made before her death on 23 July 2011. The single came out on 14 September 2011, the day she would have turned 28, with proceeds going to the Amy Winehouse Foundation, and it won the Grammy for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance. It also made Bennett, at 85, the oldest living artist to chart on the Billboard Hot 100.

notes: Third version of Body and Soul in the set, after Coleman Hawkins 1939 and Dexter Gordon 1985. Not tagged crossover: a standard sung by two vocalists on a Bennett duets album, with a jazz-trained arranger and conductor.
